name: causalfunnel-analytics
description: Simple user analytics: client-side tracker, Node.js API, MongoDB, and a Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w dashboard
